title: refactor(web): load and save the repository pack through one store
body:
Third step of the repository panel (CL-XXXX). The panel reads and writes through one store and one hook instead of calling the hub directly, so the panel UI can be built against an interface and tested against a fake.

- A store with load, write pack and write settings; the hub implementation wraps the artifact write and one tenant config patch that sets the pack pointer, posting mode, enabled, drafts and roles together, replacing the separate link and policy writes. The pointer is written only when a readable pack exists; a corrupt pack is replaced in place.
- A hook that owns the loaded, saved and draft state, stale on a version conflict, unlinked when the pack was written but the patch failed (the next save redoes only the patch), fresh reload on retry, the backlog start when triage was just switched on, and no redeploy. After a save the draft takes the normalised pack and settings, so a saved panel never shows phantom changes.
- The old settings hook, the link helper and the already-written check are deleted.

Verified: `bun run check`; web tests against the fake hub: a version conflict sets stale with no config write, a failed patch after a successful write leaves the pack unlinked and the second save sends only the patch, a save with no changes sends nothing, one patch carries all five fields, and untidy globs and duplicate role users are stored normalised with a change count of zero afterwards.

Refs CL-XXXX
author: TheGreatAxios
commits: refactor(web): load and save the repository pack through one store
